decision.topic: how many items in the do-first list, and whether to split the settings.json + restart bundle the brief itself proposed as one item
decision.conclusion: kept them as three separate numbered items (restart; two settings lines; the commit decision) plus the newly-found 22-file deletion decision, for four total
decision.why: each is independently actionable -- the owner might do the restart now and the settings paste later -- and splitting them lets the numbered list double as a literal to-do checklist rather than a bundle the reader has to mentally unpack. Four stays inside the 3-to-5 budget and every item is a genuine, verified, current need.
decision.alternative: bundle the technical trio into one list item as the brief's own draft did -- rejected because it would hide that two of the three (restart, settings) are truly one-line/one-command actions with nothing left to judge, while the third (22 files) is the only item that needs the owner to actually read something before deciding -- collapsing them together would bury that distinction.
